name: GIAC Assessing and Auditing Wireless Networks

third_party_evaluations.summary: Wireless security assessment: 802.11, Bluetooth, Zigbee, cellular.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced specialty: 3. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded wireless-assessment scope across radio protocols is a discrete specialization supported by accreditation; the very narrow use case and absent experience requirement do not establish general practitioner rank.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded wireless assessment coverage across Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee and cellular fits a distinct technical specialty. Accreditation and COOL recognition improve assurance, while zero listed experience and no recorded practical limit assumptions about seniority.

alex-novak.rationale: Assessment of wireless protocols from 802.11 through cellular is a narrow technical branch in the recorded evidence. Accreditation supports credibility, but neither the cost nor the unspecified proctored format establishes general seniority.
